Rank 1 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 5 Ki
  • Casting Time: When you take the Attack Action or roll a Combo Attack Roll
  • Range: Self
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Instantaneous

Your attacks ignite with small explosions when they connect.

You deal an additional 1d6 Fire Damage for the duration of the Attack Action or Technique that triggered this Technique's casting.
